mint.purpose: Arrival dots, lane ends, selection, the mint CTA on the night block. Never text on paper.

mint-deep.purpose: Signal marks on paper: pulses, spine fill, lit nodes, phone progress line.

mint-light.purpose: Hover state of the mint CTA.

night-text.purpose: Secondary text and lanes on the navy block.

display.purpose: Hero H1 and closing heading, two deliberate lines.

headline.purpose: Section headings and legal page titles.

lead.purpose: The hero hook question, the opening line of the headline group.

question.purpose: FAQ summaries and legal section headings.

small.purpose: Compact bar button, footer, legal field labels.

channel.purpose: Channel names where the hero lanes begin.

shadows.name: arrival-ring
shadows.purpose: Zero-blur spread expanding from 0 0 0 0 rgb(92 225 198 / 0.55) around the arrival dot, 1.8s loop; motion, not elevation.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: All state transitions (200ms controls, 240–400ms nodes and FAQ icon).

motion.name: lane-pulse
motion.purpose: SMIL travel of pulses: 3.6s hero (0.9s stagger), 5.2s trace, 4.4s finale; opacity 0→1→1→0 at 0/10/88/100%.

motion.name: scroll-line
motion.purpose: Spine fill and node lighting threshold.

components.name: Primary CTA
components.description: Navy booking button on paper; lanes arrive at its top center.
components.css: .ds-cta { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 60px; padding: 16px 28px; border-radius: 10px; background: #14173d; color: #fff; font: 650 17px/1.2 'Funnel Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-cta::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: -5px; left: 50%; width: 10px; height: 10px; margin-left: -5px; border-radius: 50%; background: #5ce1c6; } .ds-cta:hover { background: #262a5e; }

components.name: Night CTA
components.description: Mint booking button, only on the navy close.
components.css: .ds-cta-night { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 60px; padding: 16px 28px; border-radius: 10px; background: #5ce1c6; color: #14173d; font: 650 17px/1.2 'Funnel Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-cta-night:hover { background: #8deedb; }

components.name: Bar button
components.description: Compact navy button in the sticky bar.
components.css: .ds-bar-cta { padding: 11px 16px; border-radius: 8px; background: #14173d; color: #fff; font: 600 14px/1.2 'Funnel Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-bar-cta:hover { background: #262a5e; }

components.name: Path node
components.description: A point on the customer path: paper fill, 1.5px ink outline; lit, it fills Deep Mint.
components.css: :host { display: flex; gap: 16px; padding: 16px; background: #f4f5f8; } .ds-node { display: inline-block; width: 12px; height: 12px; border: 1.5px solid #14173d; border-radius: 50%; background: #f4f5f8; } .ds-node.is-lit { border-color: #0f9f84; background: #0f9f84; }

components.name: Question row
components.description: details/summary row between 1px hairlines with a drawn plus/minus.
components.html:
Was kostet das?

Im Check bekommen Sie eine klare Empfehlung.
components.css: .ds-faq { border-top: 1px solid #d6d9e6; border-bottom: 1px solid #d6d9e6; background: #f4f5f8; color: #14173d; } .ds-faq summary { position: relative; padding: 24px 56px 24px 0; cursor: pointer; font: 600 24px/1.25 'Funnel Display', system-ui, sans-serif; list-style: none; } .ds-faq summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; } .ds-faq summary::before, .ds-faq summary::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 50%; right: 6px; width: 18px; height: 2px; margin-top: -1px; background: currentColor; } .ds-faq summary::after { transform: rotate(90deg); } .ds-faq[open] summary::after { transform: rotate(0deg); } .ds-faq p { margin: 0; padding-bottom: 28px; color: #444869; font: 400 18px/1.55 'Funnel Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: Cool paper, deep brand navy and one mint signal. The page shows its mechanism instead of claiming it: drawn lanes carry the visitor from four channels into the booking button, through the mechanism into its verdict, and down the page into the closing action. Density is calm; 1px rules separate everything, never containers.
keyCharacteristics: Lanes computed from rendered boxes, redrawn per section on resize
One mint signal reserved for motion, arrival and the night CTA
Funnel Display headings with negative tracking, Funnel Sans for reading and controls
Flat: 1px rules, 10px button corners, circles only as nodes; no cards, no shadows
Width-only spacing (px and vw clamps), authored single-column phones

rules.name: The Lane Rule
rules.body: Every lane begins at something BELIVIN does and ends in an action or a verdict.

rules.name: The Lanes Stay Rule
rules.body: Reduced motion removes travel, never the path.

rules.name: The Width-Only Rule
rules.body: Layout spacing never uses vh, svh or dvh.

rules.name: The Flat Paper Rule
rules.body: Surfaces never lift; separation is a 1px rule.

rules.name: The Node Rule
rules.body: A circle always means a point on the path.

dos: Do end every lane in an action or a verdict.
Do use Ink Navy for the primary CTA on paper.
Do bind every separator in tags and fine print to the preceding item.
donts: Don't set text in mint anywhere.
Don't use cards, boxed containers, drop shadows, gradients or glow.
Don't put eyebrows or kickers above headings.
